description: This file declares functions, types, and constants for handling patches in the libgit2 library, including creating, freeing, and inspecting patch objects.

methods.name: git_patch_from_diff
methods.description: Creates a patch object from a diff list at a specified index.

methods.name: git_patch_from_blobs
methods.description: Generates a patch from the difference between two blobs.

methods.name: git_patch_from_blob_and_buffer
methods.description: Creates a patch from the difference between a blob and a buffer.

methods.name: git_patch_from_buffers
methods.description: Creates a patch from the difference between two buffers.

methods.name: git_patch_get_delta
methods.description: Retrieves the delta associated with a patch.

methods.name: git_patch_num_hunks
methods.description: Returns the number of hunks in a patch.

methods.name: git_patch_line_stats
methods.description: Gets line counts of each type in a patch.

methods.name: git_patch_get_hunk
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a specific hunk in a patch.

methods.name: git_patch_num_lines_in_hunk
methods.description: Returns the number of lines in a specific hunk.

methods.name: git_patch_get_line_in_hunk
methods.description: Provides details about a specific line in a hunk.

methods.name: git_patch_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of the patch data in bytes.

methods.name: git_patch_print
methods.description: Serializes the patch to text via a callback.

methods.name: git_patch_to_buf
methods.description: Gets the content of a patch as a single diff text.
